title: Billing Support: Case Routing and Handoffs (2027 amendment)
author: Dev Patel
body:
## Purpose
This amends the billing case routing page for two changes that took effect on 1 March 2027. Everything else on the routing page is unchanged.

## Missing usage: 60 minutes from March 2027
From 1 March 2027 the usage pipeline writes usage in hourly batches. For requests made on or after 1 March 2027, usage for successful (2xx) requests can take up to 60 minutes to appear in the Console.
- Under 60 minutes: explain the hourly batching, tell the customer when to check again, and open no case.
- Still missing after 60 minutes, with verified 2xx requests: open a Telemetry case with the request IDs.
- This replaces the 30-minute guidance in the routing table and the onboarding triage playbook for requests made from 1 March 2027. Requests made before then keep the 30-minute guidance.

## Windows in the account's billing timezone
When you collect the window for an invoice or usage case, give it in the account's billing timezone, shown on the account record (see the record format changes page), instead of UTC.

_Last reviewed 2027-03-20._
